points.description: Meteorological factors of wind speed AND vapour pressure (vapour pressure difference/humidity) both stated.
Temperature of water AND air (both temperatures) and atmospheric pressure all stated.
Heat storage by the water body stated as a factor.
Water quality (e.g. salinity/dissolved solids) AND surface area of the water body both stated.

rubric.notes: Harsh: each point needs every named factor in it, with the correct technical term; vague wording like 'weather' or 'climate' earns nothing. A wrong extra factor (not in the model list) cancels the point it sits closest to. Award a point only when all its factors are stated; otherwise 0 for that point.
